content:
# GitHub Pages setup evidence

Work order: `WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84`.
Authorization: `DEC-175b4fab-11dc-4971-bfec-466e9b1cd000`.
Permit: `PMT-534ae846-e86c-4747-9fc0-12a8279c9b3c`.

The resident merged homepage PR #2 and city-records PR #3. Before setup,
GitHub's `main:/docs/index.html` SHA-256 matched the independently inspected
revision `089760a5ff6e7276537547d2996a7bb39ceaf670bb79f3c9a0c9575b1d5b0b9b`;
the `docs` directory contained only that file. The filed preliminary
inspection `ART-901392ee-384c-496b-84bc-eb118d9a6f6c` matched the local copy.

On 2026-11-28 UTC, the GitHub Pages create API returned success for public,
HTTPS-enforced branch deployment from `main:/docs`, with address
`https://justin-leis.github.io/webe-opolis/`. At 01:35:33 UTC, the Pages API
reported status `building`; the latest build was for main commit
`b35b2e2844e01522ed5142c2a662d8a21b06046d`. The public homepage returned
HTTP 404 during the initial build. This is not a successful live verification.
Both intended GitHub link destinations independently returned HTTP 200.

Publication, rendered content and links at the public address require a later
successful check. No paid service, permissions change, domain change, or
outside-`docs` implementation change was made. Host eligibility beyond the
accepted setup, actual billing, applicable external requirements and recovery
remain unverified. This evidence is not final inspection or resident acceptance.
